author: Yffe
content: Fixed: forge::contract_tv now binds slice params VIEW-CONSISTENTLY as &[elem] (SpecType::verus_param_spelling) instead of a bare Seq<elem>, and threads them as production's slices (slice_param_names + lower_contract_expr). Production emits xs@ for EVERY slice use (bare spec_sum(xs@) AND indexed xs@.subrange(0, i as int)) mirroring the real fn signature path (tests/golden/lower/sum.verus.rs); the slice param is NOT in seq_params so the independent reference (ref_encode) emits the matching xs@.subrange — both columns typecheck under the one &[elem] binding and Z3 proves P_prod <==> P_ref. No ref_encode.rs change needed (its non-seq-bound @ path already existed). sum.loop#1.inv#2 (acc == spec_sum(&xs[..i])) now discharges Faithful (was Unverifiable). Probe confirms genuine non-vacuity: PROD = acc as nat == spec_sum(xs@.subrange(0, i as int)), REF = (acc as nat == spec_sum(xs@.subrange(0, i as int))) — a production subrange/view bug would diverge. forge tv: sum 7/7 faithful 0 skipped 0 unverifiable 0 divergent; binary_search 5/5 faithful (match ens honestly skipped, unchanged); map_kv faithful (Map/Option skips unchanged). off-corpus 200-clause run + teeth F1-F4 + #145/#146/#148 pins all green. thermite-tv has NO thermite-lower dep (independence intact). Gauntlet: cargo build/test workspace 0 failed, clippy 0 warnings, fmt clean.
